LESSON: WRITING 1.3.1 HANDWRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to write legibly and neatly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify letters of the alphabet in the language for effective communication
2. write simple sentences legibly and neatly for written communication
3. appreciate neatness and legibility in writing for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 1.3.1 HANDWRITING
This lesson teaches Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting for Grade 4 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify letters of the alphabet in the language for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write simple sentences legibly and neatly for written communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate neatness and legibility in writing for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting above.
2. Explain Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to write legibly and neatly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify letters of the alphabet in the language for effective communication
2. write simple sentences legibly and neatly for written communication
3. appreciate neatness and legibility in writing for effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
